name: Hades
label: Golpe duplo
description: A powerful TWO-WEAPON melee combo to the RIGHT. Both hooked blades must visibly strike: wind up both arms, slash the near-hand hooked blade forward across chest height, immediately slash the far-hand hooked blade forward across waist height, then recover both hands to idle. Strong side-facing torso lean, clear wide arm swings. Keep both blades attached to their own chains. Not a magical aura. STRICT side-scroller view facing RIGHT for every frame, never turn toward camera. Clear anticipation, strong action and recovery. Preserve identity and crisp bone-silver charcoal pixel art, no new colors. Keep full sprite and moving weapons inside 256x192, same planted baseline, same scale. Static camera. Transparent. Stay in place; no camera pan.
